answer_1.quote: Sentence simplification aims to make a sentence more straightforward to read and understand ... In this paper, we study the capabilities of LLMs and specific simplification models on three Portuguese datasets: PorSimplesSent, Museum-PT, and Government Language-BR.
answer_1.outputs: Simplified Portuguese sentences generated by the evaluated LLMs.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate ... using SARI, BERTScore and BLEU. These metrics are computed using the EASSE package. We also report the percentage (%) of unchanged outputs.

answer_4.quote: We conducted a human qualitative analysis of 180 system outputs using a mixed bottomup and top-down approach ... annotators answered eight binary questions: "Is the generated text a valid simplification?", "Was the content preserved?", "Was there a lexical change?", "Was there a syntactic change?", "Was there a deletion operation?", "Are there more sentences in the simplified text than in the original?", "Was there a change in the order of terms or words?", "Is the generated simplification a hallucination?"
answer_4.guideline: Eight binary questions covering validity, meaning preservation, lexical, syntactic, deletion, sentence splitting, reordering, and hallucination.
